primary_methods.title: Efficient Lifelong Learning with A-GEM
primary_methods.takeaway: A-GEM uses one sampled memory-average reference gradient and its closed-form halfspace projection. Averaged virtual-score protection is geometrically equivalent without pooled equality but can cancel distinct member-score constraints; it does not protect every member.
